_about: Journal articles that get their own page at /journal/<page>/, a Pinterest image and an RSS item. 'id' is the article's slug in the GUIDES list in index.html (the article text lives there). Add new articles to GUIDES and here, then run: python3 tools/journal_pins.py && node tools/build_journal.js

articles.pinTitle: Lucky Color for Each Day of the Week
articles.pinText: Why does every day have its own lucky color? The seven days are named after the seven classical planets, and each planet has its own color, gemstone and number. See the full planetary week and how to wear your color for good luck. #luckycolor #colorastrology #dailyluck

articles.pinTitle: Lucky Colors for All 12 Zodiac Signs
articles.pinText: Find your zodiac sign's three lucky colors, its element and ruling planet, plus your weekly power day. Aries to Pisces in one easy chart. #zodiaccolors #astrology #luckycolor #horoscope

articles.pinTitle: Find Your Lucky Color by Date of Birth
articles.pinText: Add up the digits of your birthday to get your life path number, then find your signature lucky color and gemstone. A simple numerology guide with a worked example. #numerology #lifepathnumber #luckycolor

articles.pinTitle: 10 Easy Ways to Use Your Lucky Color
articles.pinText: No need to wear head-to-toe color. Ten small, quiet ways to carry your lucky color through the day, from socks and nail polish to your phone wallpaper. Works even with a uniform. #luckycolor #goodluck #dailyritual

articles.pinTitle: Palm Reading for Beginners: The 4 Main Lines
articles.pinText: How to find your heart line, head line, life line and fate line, and what each one is said to show about love, thinking, energy and career. A simple beginner's guide to palmistry. #palmreading #palmistry #spiritual

articles.pinTitle: Lucky Colors for Love, Money and Career
articles.pinText: Which color to wear for romance, a raise or a fresh start: pink and red for love, gold and green for money, navy and purple for career. Plus the best day of the week for each. #luckycolors #moneyluck #colormeaning
